title: Government of India Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS) Rules
source: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
content: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS) is a government-backed fixed-income investment scheme available to individuals aged 60 years or above (55 years for retired defense/VRS employees). Maximum investment limit per individual is ₹30,00,000 across accounts. Tenure is 5 years, extendable by 3 years. Interest is paid quarterly on the first working day of April, July, October, and January. Investment qualifies for Section 80C tax deduction.
